groups.saying_opens: فقال لها الصداق كاملا وعليها العدة
سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قضى به

notes: Two sayings, each stored (rule 4a). Saying 1 is Ibn Mas'ud's judgment, last link «عبد الله»; Saying 2 is «فقال معقل بن سنان سمعت رسول الله ... قضى به»
Ma'qil has no transmitter from the compiler's side: his group holds the one link he speaks as. Whether this is a second route or a corroborating remark is not settled, so the ruling is needed
